string-array.name: guide_flood_steps
string-array.item: Move to higher ground or to a higher floor if you can reach it safely. Follow evacuation orders.
Never walk, swim, or drive through floodwater. Find another route.
If trapped indoors, avoid confined attics. Call emergency services or signal for help.

string-array.name: guide_power_steps
string-array.item: Keep the refrigerator and freezer closed as much as possible.
Keep generators outdoors and at least 20 feet (6.1 meters) from doors, windows, and vents. Never run one in a home or garage.
If essential medical equipment is losing power, follow your backup plan. Call emergency services if someone is in immediate danger.

string-array.name: guide_fire_steps
string-array.item: If you have a safe exit, leave immediately. Use the stairs and close doors behind you if you can do so safely.
If smoke or fire blocks your escape, close the door, call emergency services, say where you are, and signal from a window if possible.
Once outside, call emergency services and stay outside. Tell responders if anyone may still be inside.

string-array.name: guide_quake_steps
string-array.item: If indoors, stay inside during the shaking. Get low, cover your head and neck under sturdy furniture if nearby, and hold on.
If outdoors, stay outside and move away from buildings and power lines if you can do so safely.
Expect aftershocks. Avoid damaged buildings and follow local instructions.

string-array.name: guide_flood_simple
string-array.item: Go to higher ground or a higher floor if it is safe. Follow evacuation orders.
Stay out of floodwater. Find another route.
If you are trapped inside, avoid closed attics. Call or signal for help.

string-array.name: guide_power_simple
string-array.item: Keep the fridge and freezer closed as much as possible.
Run generators outdoors. Keep them at least 20 feet (6.1 meters) from doors, windows, and vents. Never run one inside a home or garage.
Use your backup plan if essential medical equipment is losing power. Call emergency services if someone is in immediate danger.

string-array.name: guide_fire_simple
string-array.item: If the exit is safe, leave now. Use the stairs. Close doors behind you if it is safe.
If fire or smoke blocks the exit, close the door. Call emergency services and say where you are. Signal from a window if you can.
Once outside, call emergency services. Stay outside. Tell responders if anyone may still be inside.

string-array.name: guide_quake_simple
string-array.item: If you are inside, stay there while the ground shakes. Get down. Cover your head and neck under sturdy furniture if nearby, and hold on.
If you are outside, stay there. Move away from buildings and power lines if safe.
There may be more shaking. Stay away from damaged buildings. Follow local instructions.

string-array.name: guide_insulin_steps
string-array.item: Check the storage instructions for your exact product. Keep it as cool as possible without freezing it.
Keep insulin out of direct sunlight and away from heat. If you use ice, take care that the insulin does not freeze.
If it may have been exposed to extreme temperatures, ask a pharmacist or your care team for advice and help getting a replacement. Do not use insulin that has frozen.

string-array.name: guide_insulin_simple
string-array.item: Read the storage instructions on your insulin. Keep it cool. Do not freeze it.
Keep it away from heat and direct sun. If you use ice, make sure the insulin does not freeze.
Was it too hot or too cold? Ask a pharmacist or your care team for help replacing it. Do not use insulin that has frozen.
